svg.title: Frozen subject-level validation distributions
svg.desc: Publication-layout derivative preserving the exact frozen rendered distributions and subject markers.
svg.text: The exact frozen violins, box plots, and 37 subject markers are retained as rendered pixels.
Only panel geometry and labels are changed; validation Dice scale is 0–1.02.
Each panel contains the same 37 anonymized validation subjects. Overall is the per-subject mean of WT, TC, and ET.
Descriptive only; no reranking, statistical test, subject selection, or metric recomputation was performed.
